glosses: A loud, emphatic, exclamation of extreme emotion, especially horror, fear, excitement, or anger; it may comprise a word or a sustained, high-pitched vowel sound.
A loud vocalisation of many animals, especially in response to pain or fear.

examples.text: I am tender-hearted by nature, and have found my eyes moist many a time over the scream of a wounded hare.

glosses: A form of singing associated with the metal and screamo styles of music. It is a loud, rough, distorted version of the voice; rather than the normal voice of the singer.

examples.text: We had a real scream of a time at the beach.
